ex.t: May I interject for a moment?
I'd like to build on that point.
Let's get back to the point.
Let me sum up the discussion so far.
We need to reach a consensus.

title.ko: 토론 진행: let me bring in · to build on · if I could just interject · to return to the point
title.en: chairing and joining discussions: bring in, build on, interject, return to the point

explain.ko: 토론과 회의를 진행하려면 사회자와 참석자 모두 적절한 표현이 필요합니다. 사회자는 시작(Let's begin), 발언자 지명(Let me bring in ...), 요약(To sum up), 마무리(Let me record what we've agreed)를 쓰고, 참석자는 끼어들기(If I could just interject ...), 덧붙이기(To build on that ...), 이의 제기(I'm not sure I agree)를 씁니다. 정중한 표현은 논의를 부드럽게 만듭니다. 본론에서 벗어나면 Let's get back to the point로 되돌립니다.
explain.en: Chairing and joining discussions both require suitable phrases. Chairs use openings (Let's begin), calling on speakers (Let me bring in ...), summaries (To sum up) and closing (Let me record what we've agreed); participants use interjecting (If I could just interject ...), building (To build on that ...) and objecting (I'm not sure I agree). Polite phrasing smooths the discussion. If it drifts, return with Let's get back to the point.

trans.ko: 1) 잠깐 끼어들어도 될까요? 2) 그 의견에 덧붙이고 싶습니다. 3) 본론으로 돌아가 봅시다.

questions.q: I'd like to ___ on that point.

items.passage: A good chair (1) balanced views from all participants. They politely ask talkative people to wrap up, and invite quieter people to (2). When discussion drags on, they summarise so far and move on to the next (3).

trans.ko: 좋은 사회자는 모든 참석자의 의견을 균형 있게 끌어냅니다. 말이 많은 사람에게는 정중하게 발언을 마무리해 달라고 요청하고, 조용한 사람에게는 의견을 묻습니다. 논의가 길어지면 지금까지의 내용을 요약하고 다음 안건으로 넘어갑니다.

items.passage:
MEMO
Tips for running a meeting
When starting, state the purpose and agenda clearly. Let one person speak at a time, and ask permission politely when interrupting. If the discussion drifts, steer back to the point, and at the end record agreements and owners.

trans.ko:
메모
회의 진행 요령
회의를 시작할 때는 목적과 의제를 분명히 알려라. 발언은 한 명씩 하도록 하고, 끼어들 때는 정중하게 허락을 구하라. 논의가 벗어나면 본론으로 돌려야 하며, 끝에서는 합의 사항과 담당자를 정리하라.

questions.q: What should be stated at the start?

items.passage: State the purpose and agenda at the start. Interrupting is never allowed in any circumstances. At the end, agreements should be recorded.

prompt.en: Write four lines for a meeting chair: opening, calling on someone, summarising, closing.

task.model: Let's begin. Let me bring in Jieun first. To sum up so far, we all agree on cutting costs. Let me record what we've agreed and close today's meeting.

model_trans.en: Let's begin. Let me bring in Jieun first. To sum up so far, we all agree on cutting costs. Let me record what we've agreed and close today's meeting.
